search_space: All 256 ordered pairs of 2-by-2 matrices over F_2, in lexicographic entry order; every commuting pair whose two matrices each have an eigenbasis over F_2 is tested for a common eigenbasis.
witness_description: No counterexample was found among commuting ordered pairs of 2-by-2 matrices over F_2 for which each matrix is individually diagonalizable over F_2.
refutation_explanation: The bounded sweep verifies only a finite matrix proxy. The quote supplies no bounds on the residue field, matrix dimension, order, or number of order-basis matrices, so this sweep cannot exhaust the stated claim.
